skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of social insurance management, including financial management, supervision, and inspection.
Develop policies and strategies for social insurance management, including organizational structure.
Analyze and evaluate social insurance management processes and policies.
Lead and inspire team members in social insurance management tasks.
Manage resources effectively and evaluate the performance of social insurance management activities.
Ensure compliance with Vietnamese laws and regulations in social insurance management.
Conduct independent research and analyze data related to social insurance management.
Effectively present research findings and analysis in social insurance management.
Manage financial aspects of social insurance, including budgeting and payment processes.
Manage investment activities of social insurance funds.
Supervise and inspect social insurance activities.
Conduct legal inspections and resolve complaints in social insurance management.
Supervise health insurance activities, including medical supervision.
Manage public administration aspects of social insurance, including policy formulation and enforcement.
